title.zh: 卷七 本紀第七 前廢帝
title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七 前廢帝 Volume 7 Annals 7: Emperor Fei I

sentences.zh: 前廢帝諱子業，小字法師，孝武帝長子也。

translations.literal: The Former Deposed Emperor's taboo name was Ziye; his childhood name was Fashi. He was the eldest son of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Fei I, taboo name Ziye, childhood name Fashi, was Emperor Xiaowu's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年正月甲申生。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, on the day jiashen of the first month, he was born.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on jiashen day in the first month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia.

sentences.zh: 世祖鎮尋陽，子業留京邑。

translations.literal: When the late emperor garrisoned Xunyang, Ziye remained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: While Emperor Xiaowu was stationed at Xunyang, Ziye stayed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 三十年，世祖入伐元凶，被囚侍中下省，將見害者數矣，卒得無恙。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, when the late emperor entered the capital to campaign against the arch-usurper, Ziye was imprisoned in the Secretariat's lower office; he was several times on the verge of being killed, but in the end came through unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, when Emperor Xiaowu marched in to attack the usurper Liu Shao, Ziye was held prisoner in the Secretariat's lower office. He narrowly escaped death more than once before finally coming through unscathed.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: When the late emperor ascended the throne, Ziye was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, Ziye was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 始未之東宮，中庶子、二率並入直永福省。

translations.literal: At first he did not go to the Eastern Palace; the junior mentors and the two commanders of the guard all entered duty at Yongfu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: At first he did not move into the Eastern Palace; his tutors and the two guard commanders were all assigned to serve at Yongfu Palace instead.

sentences.zh: 大明二年，出居東宮。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daming, he moved out to reside in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daming he took up residence in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: [1]四年，講孝經於崇正殿。

translations.literal: [1] In the fourth year, he lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: [1] In the fourth year he lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety in Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 七年，加元服。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he received the capping ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he underwent the capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 八年閏五月庚申，世祖崩，其日，太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the eighth year, on the day gengshen, the late emperor died; that same day the crown prince assumed the imperial position.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the intercalary fifth month of the eighth year Emperor Xiaowu died; that same day the crown prince ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 太宰江夏王義恭解尚書令，加中書監，驃騎大將軍柳元景加尚書令。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor, Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, was relieved of the post of Director of the Imperial Secretariat and was instead made Supervisor of the Secretariat; the General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, stepped down as Director of the Imperial Secretariat and became Supervisor of the Secretariat instead, while General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was appointed Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲子，置錄尚書，太宰江夏王義恭錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the office of Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat was established, and the Grand Tutor, Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, was made Recorder of Imperial Secretariat Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the office of Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat was established, with Grand Tutor Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, as Recorder of Imperial Secretariat Affairs.

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍柳元景加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was given the additional title of Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was granted the additional title of Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 丹陽尹永嘉王子仁為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia, Governor of Danyang, was made Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia and Governor of Danyang, was appointed Inspector of Southern Yu.

translations.literal: [2] Editorial note two stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [2] Editorial note two stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，詔曰：「朕以眇身，夙紹洪業，敬御天威，欽對靈命。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the sixth month, an edict said: "With my slight person I have long inherited the great enterprise, reverently bearing Heaven's majesty and respectfully facing the mandate of the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the sixth month an edict declared: "With my slight person I have long inherited the great enterprise, reverently bearing Heaven's majesty and respectfully facing the mandate of the spirits.

sentences.zh: 仰遵凝緒，日鑒前圖，實可以拱默守成，詒風長世。

translations.literal: Looking up to follow the settled order and daily taking the former models as my mirror, I could indeed fold my hands in silence and preserve what has been achieved, transmitting its influence to lasting generations.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to follow the settled order and taking the former models as my daily mirror, I might indeed fold my hands in silence, preserve what has been achieved, and transmit its influence to lasting generations.

sentences.zh: 而寶位告始，萬宇改屬，惟德弗明，昧于大道。

translations.literal: Yet as the precious throne has only just begun, and the myriad realms have changed their ruler, my virtue is not yet clear, and I am blind to the great Way.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as the throne has only just been taken up and the realm has changed its ruler, my virtue is not yet clear and I remain blind to the great Way.

sentences.zh: 思宣睿範，引茲簡恤，可具詢執事，詳訪民隱。

translations.literal: I wish to proclaim a wise model and extend this brief relief: let those in charge be fully consulted, and the people's hardships be thoroughly investigated.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to proclaim a wise model and extend this brief relief. Let those in charge be fully consulted and the people's hardships thoroughly investigated.

sentences.zh: 凡曲令密文，繁而傷治，[3]關市僦稅，事施一時，而姦吏舞文，妄興威福，加以氣緯舛互，[4]偏頗滋甚。

translations.literal: Whatever covert ordinances and secret statutes are numerous and harm good governance, [3] market tolls and lease taxes imposed for a moment's need, while corrupt clerks twist the written law and presumptuously wield authority and blessing, together with erratic cosmic signs [4] and ever more extreme partiality have grown severe.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever covert ordinances and secret statutes are numerous and harm good governance, [3] market tolls and lease taxes imposed for momentary needs while corrupt clerks twist the written law and presumptuously wield authority, together with erratic cosmic signs [4] and ever more extreme partiality have grown severe.

sentences.zh: 宜其寬傜輕憲，以救民切。

translations.literal: these should be broadly eased, corvée lightened, and penalties relaxed, to relieve the people's urgent distress.
translations.idiomatic: All of this should be broadly eased, corvée lightened, and penalties relaxed, to relieve the people's urgent distress.

sentences.zh: 御府諸署，事不須廣，雕文篆刻，無施於今。

translations.literal: The various offices of the Imperial Household need not be extensive; carved ornament and seal engraving are not to be used from this time forward.
translations.idiomatic: The various offices of the Imperial Household need not be extensive; carved ornament and seal engraving are not to be used from this time forward.

sentences.zh: 悉宜并省，以酬氓願。

translations.literal: All alike should be consolidated and reduced, to answer the people's wishes.
translations.idiomatic: All alike should be consolidated and reduced, to answer the people's wishes.

sentences.zh: 藩王貿貨，壹皆禁斷。

translations.literal: The trade in goods by princes of the realm is entirely forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Trade in goods by imperial princes is entirely forbidden.

sentences.zh: 外便具條以聞。

translations.literal: Those outside the capital should draw up detailed lists and report them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials outside the capital should draw up detailed lists and report them.

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，以豫州之淮南郡復為南梁郡，復分宣城還置淮南郡。

translations.literal: " On the day wuyin, Huainan Commandery in Yu Province was restored as Nanliang Commandery, and Xuancheng was again separated out to re-establish Huainan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Huainan Commandery in Yu Province was restored as Nanliang Commandery, and Xuancheng was again separated out to re-establish Huainan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以南海太守袁曇遠為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Yuan Tanyuan, Administrator of Nanhai, was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yuan Tanyuan, Administrator of Nanhai, was appointed Inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，鎮軍將軍、雍州刺史晉安王子勛改為江州刺史，中護軍宗慤為安西將軍、雍州刺史，鎮北將軍、徐州刺史湘東王彧為護軍將軍，中軍將軍義陽王昶為征北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jihai, Liu Zixun, General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Yong Province, was transferred to be Inspector of Jiang Province; Zong Que was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Province; Liu Yu, General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Xu Province, was made General Who Protects the Army; Liu Chang, General of the Center Army, was made General Who Campaigns against the North and Inspector of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zixun, General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Yong Province, was transferred to Inspector of Jiang Province; Zong Que became General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Province; Liu Yu, General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Xu Province, became General Who Protects the Army; and Liu Chang, General of the Center Army, became General Who Campaigns against the North and Inspector of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，婆皇國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the state of Pohuang sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the state of Pohuang sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 崇皇太后曰太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后。

translations.literal: The Honored Empress Dowager was styled Grand Empress Dowager, and the empress was styled Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The Honored Empress Dowager was elevated to Grand Empress Dowager, and the empress to Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，罷南北二馳道。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the northern and southern imperial speedways were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the northern and southern imperial speedways were abolished.

sentences.zh: 孝建以來所改制度，還依元嘉。

translations.literal: Institutions changed since the Xiaojian era were restored according to the Yuanjia standards.
translations.idiomatic: Institutions changed since the Xiaojian era were restored to Yuanjia standards.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，追崇獻妃為獻皇后。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the late Consort Xian was posthumously honored as Empress Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the late Consort Xian was posthumously honored as Empress Xian.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，撫軍將軍、南徐州刺史新安王子鸞解領司徒。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Liu Ziluan, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Liu Ziluan, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，領軍將軍王玄謨為鎮北將軍、青冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingmao, Wang Xuemo, Commander of the Palace Guards, was made General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the eighth month Wang Xuemo, Commander of the Palace Guards, was appointed General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: [5]己巳，以青、冀二州刺史蕭惠開為益州刺史。

translations.literal: [5] On the day jisi, Xiao Huiikai, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: [5] On jisi day Xiao Huiikai, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 己丑，[6]皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, [6] the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day [6] the Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 京師雨水。

translations.literal: Rain fell in the capital for many days.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rain fell in the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，[7]遣御史與官長隨宜賑卹。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, [7] censors were sent out together with local officials to give relief wherever appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day [7] censors were dispatched together with local officials to give relief wherever appropriate.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，護軍將軍湘東王彧為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinchou, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and General Who Protects the Army, was made Commander of the Palace Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the ninth month Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Commander of the Palace Guards.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以尚書左僕射劉遵考為特進、右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Liu Zunkao, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Special Advisor and Right Household Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Liu Zunkao, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Special Advisor and Right Household Grandee.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，文穆皇后祔葬景寧陵。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Empress Wenmu was enshrined at Jingning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Empress Wenmu was enshrined at Jingning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，太常建安王休仁為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiaxu, Liu Xiuren, Minister of Ceremonies, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the tenth month of winter Liu Xiuren, Minister of Ceremonies, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，輔國將軍宗越為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Zong Yue, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Zong Yue, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Inspector of Si Province.

sentences.zh: [8]庚辰，原除揚、南徐州大明七年逋租。

translations.literal: [8] On the day gengchen, overdue rents from the seventh year of Daming in Yang and Southern Xu provinces were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: [8] On gengchen day overdue rents from the seventh year of Daming in Yang and Southern Xu provinces were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，以尚書右僕射顏師伯為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yiyou, Yan Shibo, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the twelfth month Yan Shibo, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: [9]壬辰，以王畿諸郡為揚州，以揚州為東揚州。

translations.literal: [9] On the day renchen, the commanderies of the capital region were made into Yang Province, and Yang Province was made into Eastern Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: [9] On renchen day the commanderies of the capital region were made into Yang Province, and Yang Province was renamed Eastern Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以車騎將軍、揚州刺史豫章王子尚為司徒、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Liu Zishang, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yang Province, was made Minister of Works and Inspector of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Liu Zishang, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yang Province, was appointed Minister of Works and Inspector of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 去歲及是歲，東諸郡大旱，甚者米一升數百，京邑亦至百餘，餓死者十有六七。

translations.literal: In the previous year and in this year great drought struck the eastern commanderies; in the worst places a sheng of grain cost several hundred cash, and even in the capital it reached more than a hundred; of those who starved, six or seven out of ten died.
translations.idiomatic: In the previous year and in this year severe drought struck the eastern commanderies; in the worst places a sheng of grain cost several hundred cash, and even in the capital more than a hundred. Six or seven out of every ten people starved to death.

sentences.zh: 孝建以來，又立錢署鑄錢，百姓因此盜鑄，錢轉偽小，商貨不行。

translations.literal: Since the Xiaojian era money offices had also been established to cast coin, and because of this the common people illicitly cast as well; the cash grew counterfeit and small, and trade would not circulate.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Xiaojian era money offices had also been established to cast coin, and the common people took to counterfeiting as well; the cash grew debased and small, and commerce ceased to circulate.

sentences.zh: 永光元年春正月乙未朔，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Yongguang, on the day yiwei, the first day of the month, the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the new moon of the first month of spring in the first year of Yongguang, the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，省諸州臺傳。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the provincial relay stations were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the provincial relay stations were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以領軍將軍湘東王彧為衞將軍、南豫州刺史，護軍將軍建安王休仁為領軍將軍，祕書監山陽王休祐為豫州刺史，左衞將軍桂陽王休範為中護軍，南豫州刺史尋陽王子房為東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and Commander of the Palace Guards, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yu; Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and General Who Protects the Army, was made Commander of the Palace Guards; Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang and Supervisor of the Secretariat, was made Inspector of Yu Province; Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, was made General of the Center Guard; Liu Zifang, Prince of Xunyang and Inspector of Southern Yu, was made Inspector of Eastern Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and Commander of the Palace Guards, became General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yu; Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and General Who Protects the Army, became Commander of the Palace Guards; Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang and Supervisor of the Secretariat, became Inspector of Yu Province; Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, became General of the Center Guard; and Liu Zifang, Prince of Xunyang and Inspector of Southern Yu, became Inspector of Eastern Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，減州郡縣田祿之半。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yichou, the field stipends of provinces, commanderies, and counties were reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the second month the field stipends of provinces, commanderies, and counties were reduced by half.

sentences.zh: [10]庚寅，鑄二銖錢。

translations.literal: [10] On the day gengyin, two-zhu cash was cast.
translations.idiomatic: [10] On gengyin day two-zhu cash was cast.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，罷臨江郡。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiachen, Linjiang Commandery was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the third month Linjiang Commandery was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，割郢州隨郡屬雍州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jihai, Sui Commandery in Ying Province was detached and placed under Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the fifth month Sui Commandery in Ying Province was detached and placed under Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以後軍司馬張牧為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Zhang Mu, Rear Army Major, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Zhang Mu, Rear Army Major, was appointed Inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，左軍長史劉道隆為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jisi, Liu Daolong, Chief Clerk of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the sixth month Liu Daolong, Chief Clerk of the Left Army, was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，安西將軍、雍州刺史宗慤卒。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Zong Que, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Zong Que, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Province, died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，衞將軍、南豫州刺史湘東王彧改為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yu, was transferred to be Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yu, was transferred to Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: [11]尚書令、驃騎大將軍柳元景加南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: [11] Liu Yuanjing, Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry, was given the additional post of Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: [11] Liu Yuanjing, Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry, was given the additional post of Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛酉，越騎校尉戴法興有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day xinyou, Dai Faxing, Commandant of Elite Cavalry, was guilty of a crime and was ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eighth month of autumn Dai Faxing, Commandant of Elite Cavalry, was found guilty of a crime and ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以尚書僕射顏師伯為尚書左僕射，[12]吏部尚書王景文為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Yan Shibo, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, [12] and Wang Jingwen, Minister of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yan Shibo, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, became Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, [12] and Wang Jingwen, Minister of Personnel, became Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，帝自率宿衞兵，誅太宰江夏王義恭、尚書令驃騎大將軍柳元景、尚書左僕射顏師伯、[13]廷尉劉德願。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the emperor himself led the palace guards and executed the Grand Tutor, Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong; Liu Yuanjing, Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry; Yan Shibo, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat; [13] and Liu Deyuan, Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the emperor personally led the palace guards and executed Grand Tutor Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia; Liu Yuanjing, Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry; Yan Shibo, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat; [13] and Liu Deyuan, Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 改元為景和元年。

translations.literal: The era name was changed to the first year of Jinghe.
translations.idiomatic: The era name was changed to Jinghe.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位二等。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of nobility.

sentences.zh: 以領軍將軍建安王休仁為安西將軍、雍州刺史，衞將軍湘東王彧還為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and Commander of the Palace Guards, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Province; Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and General of the Guard, was restored as Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and Commander of the Palace Guards, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Province; Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and General of the Guard, was restored as Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，司徒、揚州刺史豫章王子尚領尚書令，射聲校尉沈文秀為青州刺史，左軍司馬崔道固為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Liu Zishang, Prince of Yuzhang, Minister of Works and Inspector of Yang Province, took the concurrent post of Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Shen Wenxiu, Commandant of Archers, was made Inspector of Qing Province; Cui Daogu, Major of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Liu Zishang, Prince of Yuzhang, Minister of Works and Inspector of Yang Province, took the concurrent post of Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Shen Wenxiu, Commandant of Archers, was appointed Inspector of Qing Province; and Cui Daogu, Major of the Left Army, was appointed Inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔曰：「昔凝神佇逸，磻溪讚道，湛慮思才，傅巖毗化。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict said: "In antiquity, when one concentrated the spirit and waited in stillness, Panxi praised the Way; when one steeped the mind in thought of talent, Fuyan assisted in transformation.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict declared: "In antiquity, when one concentrated the spirit and waited in stillness, Panxi praised the Way; when one steeped the mind in thought of talent, Fuyan assisted in transformation.

sentences.zh: 朕位御三極，風澄萬宇，資鈇電斷，正卯斯戮。

translations.literal: I occupy the three extremities of rank, and the winds are clear throughout the myriad realms; with the axe and lightning of judgment I sever and execute at the hour of mao.
translations.idiomatic: I occupy the summit of the three ranks, and the winds are clear throughout the realm; with the axe and lightning of judgment I sever and execute at the hour of mao.

sentences.zh: 思所以仰宣遺烈，俯弘景祚，每結夢庖鼎，瞻言板築，有劬日昃，無忘昧旦。

translations.literal: I think how to look up and proclaim the legacy left behind, and look down to extend the splendor of the age; night and day I am troubled as though dreaming of the cauldron at Pao and gaze toward the boards at Ban—never forgetting the dawn even at the time of rize.
translations.idiomatic: I think how to look up and proclaim the legacy left behind and look down to extend the splendor of the age. Night and day I am troubled as though dreaming of the cauldron at Pao and gazing toward the boards at Ban, never forgetting the dawn even at the hour of rize.

sentences.zh: 可甄訪郡國，招聘閭部：其有孝性忠節，幽居遯棲，信誠義行，廉正表俗，文敏博識，幹事治民，務加旌舉，隨才引擢。

translations.literal: Let commanderies and states be examined and recruited from among the districts: whoever has filial conduct and loyal integrity, dwells in seclusion in the deep hills, keeps faith and righteous action, is pure and upright and sets an example for custom, is cultured, quick, and broadly learned, or is capable in affairs and governs the people—such persons are to be especially commended and promoted according to their talents.
translations.idiomatic: Let commanderies and states be examined and talent recruited from among the districts: whoever shows filial conduct and loyal integrity, dwells in seclusion in the deep hills, keeps faith and righteous action, is pure and upright and sets an example for custom, is cultured, quick, and broadly learned, or is capable in affairs and governs the people—such persons are to be especially commended and promoted according to their talents.

sentences.zh: 庶官克順，彝倫咸叙。

translations.literal: Thus officials will fulfill their duties, and the norms of human relations will all be ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Thus officials will fulfill their duties, and the norms of human relations will all be set in order.

sentences.zh: 主者精加詳括，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: Those in charge should carefully examine and report in detail, as my mind desires.
translations.idiomatic: Those in charge should carefully examine and report in detail, as I intend.

sentences.zh: 」以始興公沈慶之為太尉，鎮北將軍、青冀二州刺史王玄謨為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: " Shen Qingzhi, Duke of Shixing, was made Grand Marshal; Wang Xuemo, General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was made Commander of the Palace Guards.
translations.idiomatic: " Shen Qingzhi, Duke of Shixing, was appointed Grand Marshal; Wang Xuemo, General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was appointed Commander of the Palace Guards.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以石頭城為長樂宮，東府城為未央宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Stone City was made into the Changle Palace, and the Eastern Headquarters city was made into the Weiyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Stone City was made into Changle Palace, and the Eastern Headquarters city into Weiyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 罷東揚州并揚州。

translations.literal: Eastern Yang Province was abolished and merged into Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Yang Province was abolished and merged into Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以北邸為建章宮，南第為長楊宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the northern mansions were made into Jianzhang Palace, and the southern mansions into Changyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the northern mansions were made into Jianzhang Palace, and the southern mansions into Changyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 以冠軍將軍邵陵王子元為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Ziyuan, Prince of Shaoling and General Who Champions the Army, was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ziyuan, Prince of Shaoling and General Who Champions the Army, was appointed Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，原除吳、吳興、義興、晉陵、琅邪五郡大明八年以前逋租。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, overdue rents before the eighth year of Daming in the five commanderies of Wu, Wuxing, Yixing, Jinling, and Langya were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day overdue rents before the eighth year of Daming in the five commanderies of Wu, Wuxing, Yixing, Jinling, and Langya were remitted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復立南北二馳道。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the northern and southern imperial speedways were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the northern and southern imperial speedways were restored.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，車駕幸湖熟，奏鼓吹。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guisi, the imperial carriage visited Hushu, where martial music was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day in the ninth month the emperor visited Hushu, where martial music was performed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以南兗州刺史永嘉王子仁為南徐州刺史，丹陽尹始安王子真為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia and Inspector of Southern Yan, was made Inspector of Southern Xu; Liu Zizhen, Prince of Shi'an and Governor of Danyang, was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia and Inspector of Southern Yan, was appointed Inspector of Southern Xu; Liu Zizhen, Prince of Shi'an and Governor of Danyang, was appointed Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，撫軍將軍、南徐州刺史新安王子鸞免為庶人，賜死。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Liu Ziluan, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu, was demoted to commoner and ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Liu Ziluan, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu, was demoted to commoner status and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以兗州刺史薛安都為平北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Xue Andu, Inspector of Yan Province, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Xue Andu, Inspector of Yan Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 丁未，衞將軍湘東王彧加開府儀同三司，特進、右光祿大夫劉遵考為安西將軍、南豫州刺史，寧朔將軍殷孝祖為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and General of the Guard, was given the additional title of Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies; Liu Zunkao, Special Advisor and Right Household Grandee, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yu; Yin Xiaozu was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and General of the Guard, was granted the additional title of Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies; Liu Zunkao, Special Advisor and Right Household Grandee, became General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yu; and Yin Xiaozu was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以前梁、南秦二州刺史柳元怙復為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Liu Yuanku, former Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was restored as Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Liu Yuanku, former Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was restored as Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕討征北將軍、徐州刺史義陽王昶，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the imperial carriage campaigned against Liu Chang, Prince of Yiyang, General Who Campaigns against the North and Inspector of Xu Province; within and without the court martial law was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the emperor marched against Liu Chang, Prince of Yiyang, General Who Campaigns against the North and Inspector of Xu Province; martial law was proclaimed within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 昶奔于索虜。

translations.literal: Liu Chang fled to the northern barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang fled to the northern barbarians.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，右將軍、豫州刺史山陽王休祐進號鎮西大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang and Inspector of Yu Province, was promoted to General Who Guards the West.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang and Inspector of Yu Province, was promoted to General Who Guards the West.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以安西長史袁顗為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Yuan Yi, Chief Clerk of the Army Who Pacifies the West, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Yuan Yi, Chief Clerk of the Army Who Pacifies the West, was appointed Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以左民尚書劉思考為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Liu Kaokao, Minister of the Left for the People, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Liu Kaokao, Minister of the Left for the People, was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 是日解嚴，車駕幸瓜步。

translations.literal: That same day martial law was lifted, and the imperial carriage visited Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: That same day martial law was lifted, and the emperor visited Guabu.

sentences.zh: 開百姓鑄錢。

translations.literal: The common people were permitted to cast coin.
translations.idiomatic: Private coinage by the common people was permitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，曲赦徐州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guihai, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the tenth month of winter a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 以建安王休仁為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 己卯，東陽太守王藻下獄死。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Wang Zao, Administrator of Dongyang, was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Wang Zao, Administrator of Dongyang, was imprisoned and put to death.

sentences.zh: 以宮人謝貴嬪為夫人，加虎賁靸戟，鸞輅龍旂，出警入蹕，實新蔡公主也。

translations.literal: The palace woman Xie Guibin was made Lady, with Tiger Guards bearing halberds, imperial chariot and dragon banners, and clearance when going out and returning; she was in fact the Princess of Xincai.
translations.idiomatic: The palace woman Xie Guibin was made Lady, with Tiger Guards bearing halberds, imperial chariot and dragon banners, and imperial escort when going out and returning—in fact she was Princess of Xincai.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以鎮西大將軍、豫州刺史山陽王休祐為鎮軍大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Guards the Army and Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Guards the Army and Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.

translations.literal: [14] Editorial note fourteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [14] Editorial note fourteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，寧朔將軍何邁下獄死。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renchen, He Mai, General Who Pacifies the North, was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the eleventh month He Mai, General Who Pacifies the North, was imprisoned and put to death.

sentences.zh: 新除太尉沈慶之薨。

translations.literal: Shen Qingzhi, newly appointed Grand Marshal, died.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Qingzhi, newly appointed Grand Marshal, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，立皇后路氏，四廂奏樂。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Lady Lu was installed as empress, with music in all four side chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Lady Lu was installed as empress, with music in all four side chambers.

sentences.zh: 赦揚、南徐二州。

translations.literal: An amnesty was proclaimed for Yang and Southern Xu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed for Yang and Southern Xu provinces.

sentences.zh: 護軍將軍建安王休仁加特進、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and General Who Protects the Army, was made Special Advisor and Left Household Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Special Advisor and Left Household Grandee.

sentences.zh: 中護軍桂陽王休範遷職。

translations.literal: Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang and General of the Center Guard, was transferred to another post.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang and General of the Center Guard, was transferred to another post.

sentences.zh: 丁未，皇子生，少府劉勝之子也。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, a prince was born—the son of Liu Sheng of the Palace Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day a prince was born, the son of Liu Sheng of the Palace Storehouse.

sentences.zh: [15]大赦天下。

translations.literal: [15] A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: [15] A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 贓汙淫盜，悉皆原除。

translations.literal: Corruption, defilement, and theft were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Offenses of corruption, defilement, and theft were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 賜為父後者爵一級。

translations.literal: Those who had been adopted as heirs to their fathers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had been adopted as heirs to their fathers were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以特進、左光祿大夫、護軍將軍建安王休仁為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, Special Advisor, Left Household Grandee, and General Who Protects the Army, was made General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry and Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, Special Advisor, Left Household Grandee, and General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General-in-Chief Who Pacifies the Cavalry and Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，南平王敬猷、廬陵王敬先、安南侯敬淵並賜死。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Liu Jingyou, Prince of Nanping; Liu Jingxian, Prince of Luling; and Liu Jingyuan, Marquis of Annan, were all ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Liu Jingyou, Prince of Nanping; Liu Jingxian, Prince of Luling; and Liu Jingyuan, Marquis of Annan, were all ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 時帝凶悖日甚，誅殺相繼，內外百司，不保首領。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor's cruelty and perversity grew daily worse; executions followed one after another, and within and without the hundred offices no one could keep his head.
translations.idiomatic: By then the emperor's cruelty and perversity grew worse by the day. Executions followed one after another, and within and without the hundred offices no one could be sure of keeping his head.

sentences.zh: 先是訛言云：「湘中出天子。

translations.literal: Earlier a false report had circulated, saying: "A Son of Heaven will arise in Xiang."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a rumor had circulated: "A Son of Heaven will arise in Xiang."

sentences.zh: 」帝將南巡荊、湘二州以厭之。

translations.literal: The emperor intended to tour the two provinces of Jing and Xiang to suppress it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor planned a southern tour of Jing and Xiang provinces to suppress the omen.

sentences.zh: 先欲誅諸叔，然後發引。

translations.literal: He first wished to execute his uncles, and only then set out on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: He intended first to execute his uncles, and only then set out on the journey.

sentences.zh: 太宗與左右阮佃夫、王道隆、李道兒密結帝左右壽寂之、姜產之等十一人，謀共廢帝。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiangdong secretly joined with his attendants Ruan Tianfu, Wang Daolong, and Li Dao'er in plotting with eleven men among the emperor's close attendants, including Shou Jizhi and Jiang Chengzhi, to depose the emperor together.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Xiangdong secretly joined with his attendants Ruan Tianfu, Wang Daolong, and Li Dao'er to plot with eleven of the emperor's close attendants, including Shou Jizhi and Jiang Chengzhi, to depose him together.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜，帝於華林園竹林堂射鬼。

translations.literal: At midnight on the day wuwu, the emperor was at the Bamboo Grove Hall in Hualin Garden shooting at ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on wuwu day the emperor was in the Bamboo Grove Hall at Hualin Garden shooting at ghosts.

sentences.zh: 時巫覡云：「此堂有鬼。

translations.literal: At that time the shamans said: "There are ghosts in this hall."
translations.idiomatic: The shamans had said, "There are ghosts in this hall."

sentences.zh: 」故帝自射之。

translations.literal: Therefore the emperor shot at them himself.
translations.idiomatic: That was why the emperor had gone to shoot at them himself.

sentences.zh: 壽寂之懷刀直入，姜產之為副。

translations.literal: Shou Jizhi, carrying a knife, went straight in; Jiang Chengzhi was his assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Shou Jizhi, carrying a knife, went straight in, with Jiang Chengzhi as his assistant.

sentences.zh: 帝欲走，寂之追而殞之。

translations.literal: The emperor tried to flee; Jizhi pursued him and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor tried to flee; Jizhi pursued him and killed him.

sentences.zh: 時年十七。

translations.literal: He was seventeen years old.
translations.idiomatic: He was seventeen years old.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后令曰：

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager issued an order, saying:
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager issued an order:

sentences.zh: 司徒領護軍八座：子業雖曰嫡長，少稟凶毒，不仁不孝，著自髫齔。

translations.literal: To the Minister of Works, Commander of the Palace Guards, and the Eight Excellencies: Although Ziye was called the eldest son of the proper wife, from youth he received a vicious and poisonous nature; unkindness and unfilial conduct were evident from the time he wore his hair in tufts.
translations.idiomatic: To the Minister of Works, Commander of the Palace Guards, and the Eight Excellencies: Although Ziye was the eldest son of the proper wife, from youth he showed a vicious and poisonous nature; unkindness and unfilial conduct were evident from childhood.

sentences.zh: 孝武棄世，屬當辰曆。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu left the world, the throne fell to him by the calendar's turn.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu died, the throne fell to him by right of succession.

sentences.zh: 自梓宮在殯，喜容靦然，天罰重離，歡恣滋甚。

translations.literal: From the time the imperial coffin lay in mourning, his face was bright and cheerful; Heaven punished him with the loss of his mother, yet his wanton joy only increased.
translations.idiomatic: From the moment the imperial coffin lay in mourning his face was bright and cheerful; though Heaven punished him with the loss of his mother, his wanton joy only increased.

sentences.zh: 逼以內外維持，忍虐未露，而凶慘難抑，一旦肆禍，遂縱戮上宰，殄害輔臣。

translations.literal: Forced by inner and outer constraints to maintain appearances, his cruel tyranny was not yet exposed; but once his vicious savagery could no longer be restrained, he unleashed disaster in a single day, wantonly slaughtering the chief ministers and annihilating his supporting officials.
translations.idiomatic: Forced by inner and outer constraints to maintain appearances, his cruel tyranny was not yet exposed; but once his vicious savagery could no longer be restrained, he unleashed disaster in a single day, wantonly slaughtering the chief ministers and destroying his supporting officials.

sentences.zh: 子鸞兄弟，先帝鍾愛，含怨既往，枉加屠酷。

translations.literal: Ziluan and his brothers were dearly loved by the late emperor; Ziye harbored resentment over the past and wrongly subjected them to cruel slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: Ziluan and his brothers had been dearly loved by the late emperor; Ziye harbored old resentment and wrongly subjected them to cruel slaughter.

sentences.zh: 昶茂親作扞，橫相徵討。

translations.literal: Chang, a close kinsman, served as a shield, yet Ziye raised troops against him without cause.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang, a close kinsman who should have served as a shield, was attacked without cause.

sentences.zh: 新蔡公主逼離夫族，幽置深宮，詭云薨殞。

translations.literal: The Princess of Xincai was forced away from her husband's clan and secretly placed in the deep palace; it was falsely announced that she had died.
translations.idiomatic: The Princess of Xincai was torn from her husband's clan and hidden in the deep palace, while it was falsely announced that she had died.

sentences.zh: 襄事甫爾，喪禮頓釋，昏酣長夜，庶事傾遺。

translations.literal: The mourning rites had scarcely begun when he abruptly cast them off; drunk and dazed through the long night, he neglected every affair of state.
translations.idiomatic: The mourning rites had scarcely begun when he abruptly cast them off; drunk and dazed through the long night, he neglected every affair of state.

sentences.zh: 朝賢舊勳，棄若遺土。

translations.literal: The court's worthies and old ministers he discarded like thrown-away soil.
translations.idiomatic: The court's worthies and old ministers he discarded like thrown-away soil.

sentences.zh: 管絃不輟，珍羞備膳。

translations.literal: Pipes and strings never ceased; rare delicacies filled every table.
translations.idiomatic: Music never ceased; rare delicacies filled every table.

sentences.zh: 詈辱祖考，以為戲謔。

translations.literal: He reviled his ancestors and made them the butt of his jests.
translations.idiomatic: He reviled his ancestors and made them the butt of his jests.

sentences.zh: 行游莫止，淫縱無度。

translations.literal: His travels knew no stopping; his lewdness and excess had no limit.
translations.idiomatic: His travels knew no stopping; his lewdness and excess had no limit.

sentences.zh: 肆宴園陵，規圖發掘。

translations.literal: He feasted in the imperial tombs and plotted to excavate them.
translations.idiomatic: He feasted in the imperial tombs and plotted to excavate them.

sentences.zh: 誅剪無辜，籍略婦女。

translations.literal: He executed the innocent and seized women by force.
translations.idiomatic: He executed the innocent and seized women by force.

sentences.zh: 建樹偽豎，莫知誰息。

translations.literal: He raised false heirs, and no one knew whose child would survive.
translations.idiomatic: He raised false heirs, and no one knew whose child would survive.

sentences.zh: 拜嬪立后，慶過恒典。

translations.literal: In appointing concubines and installing empresses, his celebrations exceeded the constant statutes.
translations.idiomatic: In appointing concubines and installing empresses, his celebrations exceeded the regular statutes.

sentences.zh: 宗室密戚，遇若婢僕，鞭捶陵曳，無復尊卑。

translations.literal: Clansmen and close kin he treated like maidservants and slaves, beating and dragging them with no regard for rank.
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen and close kin he treated like maidservants and slaves, beating and dragging them with no regard for rank.

sentences.zh: 南平一門，特鍾其酷。

translations.literal: The house of Nanping alone received his special cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: The house of Nanping alone received his special cruelty.

sentences.zh: 反天滅理，顯暴萬端。

translations.literal: He reversed Heaven and extinguished principle; his open violence had ten thousand forms.
translations.idiomatic: He reversed Heaven and extinguished principle; his open violence had ten thousand forms.

sentences.zh: 苛罰酷令，終無紀極，夏桀、殷辛，未足以譬。

translations.literal: Harsh punishments and cruel ordinances knew no end; Xia Jie and Yin Xin would not suffice for comparison.
translations.idiomatic: Harsh punishments and cruel ordinances knew no end; even Xia Jie and King Zhou of Yin would not suffice for comparison.

sentences.zh: 闔朝業業，人不自保，百姓遑遑，手足靡厝。

translations.literal: The whole court trembled in fear and no one could protect himself; the common people were frantic, with nowhere to set hand or foot.
translations.idiomatic: The whole court trembled in fear and no one could protect himself; the common people were frantic, with nowhere to set hand or foot.

sentences.zh: 行穢禽獸，罪盈三千。

translations.literal: His conduct was filthier than that of birds and beasts; his crimes filled the three thousand categories.
translations.idiomatic: His conduct was filthier than that of birds and beasts; his crimes filled the three thousand categories.

sentences.zh: 高祖之業將泯，七廟之享幾絕。

translations.literal: The enterprise of the High Ancestor was on the verge of perishing; the sacrifices of the seven temples nearly came to an end.
translations.idiomatic: The enterprise of the High Ancestor was on the verge of perishing; the sacrifices of the seven temples nearly came to an end.

sentences.zh: 吾老疾沈篤，每規禍鴆，憂煎漏刻，氣命無幾。

translations.literal: My old illness is deep and grave; I constantly foresee this poisoned calamity, my worry burning through each watch, and my breath and life have little time left.
translations.idiomatic: My old illness is deep and grave; I constantly foresee this poisoned calamity, my worry burning through each watch, and my breath and life have little time left.

sentences.zh: 開闢以降，所未嘗聞。

translations.literal: Since the opening of the age, such a thing has never been heard of.
translations.idiomatic: Since the opening of the age, such a thing has never been heard of.

sentences.zh: 遠近思奮，十室而九。

translations.literal: Near and far yearn to rise up; nine houses in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Near and far yearn to rise up; nine households in ten.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍湘東王體自太祖，天縱英聖，文皇鍾愛，寵冠列藩。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiangdong, Liu Yu, by body descends from the Great Ancestor; Heaven endowed him with heroic sagacity, and Emperor Wen cherished him, his favor surpassing all the other princes.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Xiangdong, Liu Yu, was descended in body from Emperor Wen; Heaven endowed him with heroic sagacity, and Emperor Wen cherished him above all the other princes.

sentences.zh: 吾早識神睿，特兼常禮。

translations.literal: I recognized his divine brilliance early and treated him with special courtesy beyond the ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: I recognized his divine brilliance early and treated him with special courtesy beyond the ordinary.

sentences.zh: 潛運宏規，義士投袂，獨夫既殞，懸首白旗，社稷再興，宗祏永固，人鬼屬心，大命允集。

translations.literal: He secretly carried out a great design; men of righteousness rallied to him; once the tyrant had fallen, his severed head hung from the white banner; the altars of state were renewed, the ancestral temple secured forever; the hearts of men and ghosts turned to him, and the great mandate was duly gathered.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly carried out a great design; men of righteousness rallied to him; once the tyrant had fallen, his severed head hung from the white banner; the altars of state were renewed and the ancestral temple secured forever; the hearts of men and ghosts turned to him, and the great mandate was duly gathered.

sentences.zh: 且勳德高邈，大業攸歸，宜遵漢、晉，纂承皇極。

translations.literal: Moreover his merit and virtue are lofty and far-reaching, and the great enterprise is his to receive; he should follow Han and Jin in ascending the imperial extremity.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover his merit and virtue are lofty and far-reaching, and the great enterprise is his to receive; he should follow the precedents of Han and Jin in ascending the throne.

sentences.zh: 主者詳舊典以時奉行。

translations.literal: Those in charge should examine the old statutes and carry them out in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: Those in charge should examine the old statutes and carry them out in timely fashion.

sentences.zh: 未亡人餘年不幸嬰此百艱，永尋情事，雖存若殞。

translations.literal: I, the surviving remnant, have in my remaining years unhappily encountered this hundredfold hardship; forever recalling these events, though I live I am as if dead.
translations.idiomatic: I, the surviving remnant, have in my remaining years unhappily encountered this hundredfold hardship; forever recalling these events, though I live I am as if dead.

sentences.zh: 當復奈何！

translations.literal: What is to be done!
translations.idiomatic: What is to be done!

sentences.zh: 當復奈何！

translations.literal: What is to be done!
translations.idiomatic: What is to be done!

sentences.zh: 葬廢帝丹陽秣陵縣南郊壇西。

translations.literal: The deposed emperor was buried west of the southern suburban altar in Moling County, Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: The deposed emperor was buried west of the southern suburban altar in Moling County, Danyang.

sentences.zh: 帝幼而狷急，在東宮每為世祖所責。

translations.literal: The emperor from youth was impatient and narrow; in the Eastern Palace he was often rebuked by the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: From youth the emperor was impatient and narrow; in the Eastern Palace he was often rebuked by Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 世祖西巡，子業啟參承起居，書迹不謹，上詰讓之。

translations.literal: When the late emperor toured the west, Ziye submitted reports on daily matters; his writing was careless, and the emperor interrogated and reproved him.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu toured the west, Ziye submitted reports on daily matters; his writing was careless, and the emperor interrogated and reproved him.

sentences.zh: 子業啟事陳謝，上又答曰：「書不長進，此是一條耳。

translations.literal: Ziye submitted a memorial apologizing, and the emperor again replied: "Your writing does not improve—this is one matter.
translations.idiomatic: Ziye submitted a memorial of apology, and the emperor again replied: "Your writing does not improve—this is one matter.

sentences.zh: 聞汝素都懈怠，狷戾日甚，何以頑固乃爾邪！

translations.literal: I hear you have always been idle and lax, and your perversity grows worse by the day—why are you so stubbornly incorrigible!"
translations.idiomatic: I hear you have always been idle and lax, and your perversity grows worse by the day—why are you so stubbornly incorrigible!"

sentences.zh: 」初踐阼，受璽紱，悖然無哀容。

translations.literal: When he first ascended the throne and received the seal and ribbon, his face was defiant and without any look of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When he first ascended the throne and received the seal and ribbon, his face was defiant and showed no sign of mourning.

sentences.zh: 始猶難諸大臣及戴法興等，既殺法興，諸大臣莫不震懾。

translations.literal: At first he still found the great ministers and Dai Faxing and others difficult to deal with; after he killed Faxing, none of the great ministers failed to tremble in fear.
translations.idiomatic: At first he still found the great ministers and Dai Faxing difficult to deal with; after he killed Faxing, none of the great ministers failed to tremble in fear.

sentences.zh: 於是又誅羣公。

translations.literal: Then he again executed the lords of the court.
translations.idiomatic: Then he executed the lords of the court as well.

sentences.zh: 元凱以下，皆被毆捶牽曳。

translations.literal: From Yuan Kai downward, all were beaten and dragged along.
translations.idiomatic: From Yuan Kai downward, all were beaten and dragged along.

sentences.zh: 內外危懼，殿省騷然。

translations.literal: Within and without there was peril and fear; the palace offices were in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Within and without there was peril and fear; the palace offices were in uproar.

sentences.zh: 初太后疾篤，遣呼帝。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager's illness became critical, she sent to summon the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager's illness became critical, she sent to summon the emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「病人間多鬼，可畏，那可往。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Sickrooms are full of ghosts—how dreadful! How could I go there?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Sickrooms are full of ghosts—how dreadful! How could I go there?"

sentences.zh: 」太后怒，語侍者：「將刀來，破我腹，那得生如此寧馨兒！

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager in anger told her attendants: "Bring a knife and cut open my belly—how could I have borne such a precious darling!"
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager in anger told her attendants, "Bring a knife and cut open my belly—how could I have borne such a precious darling!"

sentences.zh: 」及太后崩後數日，帝夢太后謂之曰：「汝不孝不仁，本無人君之相。

translations.literal: Several days after the Empress Dowager's death, the emperor dreamed that the Empress Dowager said to him: "You are unfilial and unkind; by nature you lack the bearing of a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Several days after the Empress Dowager's death, the emperor dreamed that she said to him, "You are unfilial and unkind; by nature you lack the bearing of a ruler.

sentences.zh: 子尚愚悖如此，亦非運祚所及。

translations.literal: Zishang is foolish and perverse to this degree; he too is not what fortune and mandate can sustain.
translations.idiomatic: Zishang is foolish and perverse to this degree; he too is not what fortune and mandate can sustain.

sentences.zh: 孝武險虐滅道，怨結人神，兒子雖多，並無天命。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu was dangerous and cruel, extinguishing the Way; resentment joined men and spirits. Though he had many sons, none had Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu was dangerous and cruel, extinguishing the Way; resentment joined men and spirits. Though he had many sons, none had Heaven's mandate.

sentences.zh: 大運所歸，應還文帝之子。

translations.literal: Where the great fortune turns belongs by right to a son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Where the great fortune turns belongs by right to a son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 」其後湘東王紹位，果文帝子也。

translations.literal: Afterward, when the Prince of Xiangdong succeeded to the throne, he was indeed a son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, when the Prince of Xiangdong succeeded to the throne, he was indeed a son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 故帝聚諸叔京邑，慮在外為患。

translations.literal: Therefore the emperor gathered his uncles in the capital, fearing they would become a threat if left outside.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the emperor gathered his uncles in the capital, fearing they would become a threat if left outside.

sentences.zh: 山陰公主淫恣過度，謂帝曰：「妾與陛下，雖男女有殊，俱託體先帝。

translations.literal: The Princess of Shanyin was licentious beyond measure; she said to the emperor: "Your Majesty and I, though man and woman differ, both owe our bodies to the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The Princess of Shanyin was licentious beyond measure; she said to the emperor, "Your Majesty and I, though man and woman differ, both owe our bodies to the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 陛下六宮萬數，而妾唯駙馬一人。

translations.literal: Your Majesty has ten thousand women in the six palaces, while I have only one husband by marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has ten thousand women in the six palaces, while I have only one husband by marriage.

sentences.zh: 事不均平，一何至此！

translations.literal: How extremely unequal is this affair!"
translations.idiomatic: How extremely unequal is this!"

sentences.zh: 」帝乃為主置面首左右三十人；

translations.literal: The emperor then set up thirty male favorites for the princess on left and right;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then set up thirty male favorites for the princess on left and right;

sentences.zh: 進爵會稽郡長公主，秩同郡王，食湯沐邑二千戶，[16]給鼓吹一部，加班劍二十人。

translations.literal: her rank was advanced to Princess of Kuaiji Commandery, with precedence equal to a prince of a commandery, a fief of two thousand households for bath and lodging, [16] one set of martial music granted, and twenty guards with drawn swords added.
translations.idiomatic: her rank was advanced to Princess of Kuaiji Commandery, with precedence equal to a commandery prince, a fief of two thousand households for bath and lodging, [16] one set of martial music granted, and twenty guards with drawn swords added.

sentences.zh: 帝每出，與朝臣常共陪輦。

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor went out, he commonly shared the imperial carriage with court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor went out, he commonly shared the imperial carriage with court ministers.

sentences.zh: 主以吏部郎褚淵貌美，就帝請以自侍，帝許之。

translations.literal: The princess, because Chu Yuan of the Ministry of Personnel was handsome in appearance, asked the emperor to take him to serve her; the emperor consented.
translations.idiomatic: The princess, finding Chu Yuan of the Ministry of Personnel handsome, asked the emperor to lend him to serve her; the emperor consented.

sentences.zh: 淵侍主十日，備見逼迫，誓死不回，遂得免。

translations.literal: Yuan attended the princess for ten days, was pressed on every side, and swore he would rather die than yield; only then was he released.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan attended the princess for ten days, was pressed on every side, and swore he would rather die than yield; only then was he released.

sentences.zh: 帝所幸閹人華願兒，官至散騎常侍，加將軍帶郡。

translations.literal: Hua Yuan'er, a eunuch favored by the emperor, reached the post of Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and was made a general with a commandery attached.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Yuan'er, a eunuch favored by the emperor, reached the post of Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and was made a general with a commandery attached.

sentences.zh: 帝少好讀書，[17]頗識古事，自造世祖誄及雜篇章，往往有辭采。

translations.literal: The emperor from youth loved reading, [17] was quite learned in antiquities, and himself composed the dirge for the late emperor and miscellaneous compositions; they often had literary color.
translations.idiomatic: From youth the emperor loved reading, [17] was quite learned in antiquities, and himself composed the dirge for Emperor Xiaowu and miscellaneous compositions that often showed literary polish.

sentences.zh: 以魏武帝有發丘中郎將、摸金校尉，乃置此二官。

translations.literal: Because Emperor Wu of Wei had had the offices of Director Who Opens Tombs and Colonel Who Gropes for Gold, he established these two offices.
translations.idiomatic: Because Emperor Wu of Wei had had the offices of Director Who Opens Tombs and Colonel Who Gropes for Gold, he established these two offices.

sentences.zh: 以建安王休仁、山陽王休祐領之。

translations.literal: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, and Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, were made to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, and Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, were placed in command of them.

sentences.zh: [18]其餘事迹，分見諸列傳。

translations.literal: [18] His other deeds are set forth separately in the various biographies.
translations.idiomatic: [18] His other deeds are set forth separately in the various biographies.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：廢帝之事行著于篇。

translations.literal: The historian says: The deeds of the deposed emperor are set forth in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: The deeds of the deposed emperor are set forth in this chapter.

sentences.zh: 若夫武王數殷紂之釁，不能絓其萬一；

translations.literal: If King Wu enumerated the crimes of King Zhou of Yin, he could not have caught one part in ten thousand;
translations.idiomatic: If King Wu enumerated the crimes of King Zhou of Yin, he could not have caught one part in ten thousand;

sentences.zh: 霍光書昌邑之過，未足舉其毫釐。

translations.literal: when Huo Guang wrote out the faults of the Marquis of Haihun, he could not have listed one hair's breadth in a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: when Huo Guang wrote out the faults of the Marquis of Haihun, he could not have listed one hair's breadth in a thousand.

sentences.zh: 假以中才之君，有一于此，足以霣社殘宗，汚宮瀦廟，況總斯惡以萃一人之體乎！

translations.literal: Suppose a ruler of middling talent had even one of these faults— that would be enough to destroy the altars of state, ruin the ancestral clan, defile the palace and flood the temple; how much more when all these evils were gathered in a single person's body!
translations.idiomatic: Suppose a ruler of middling talent had even one of these faults—that would be enough to destroy the altars of state, ruin the ancestral clan, and defile the palace and temple; how much more when all these evils were gathered in a single person's body!

sentences.zh: 其得亡亦為幸矣。

translations.literal: That he escaped destruction was itself a piece of good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: That he escaped destruction was itself a piece of good fortune.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 出居東宮 各本並脫「居」字，據元龜二五六補。

translations.literal: Moved out to reside in the Eastern Palace: All editions omit the character 「reside」; it is supplied from Imperial Readings 256.
translations.idiomatic: 「Moved out to reside in the Eastern Palace」: Every edition omits 「reside」; the character is restored from Imperial Readings 256.

sentences.zh: 丹陽尹永嘉王子仁為南豫州刺史 「南豫」子仁傳作「南兗」。

translations.literal: Liu Ziren, Governor of Danyang, Prince of Yongjia, was made Inspector of Southern Yu: In Ziren's biography 「Southern Yu」 appears as 「Southern Yan」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Liu Ziren, Governor of Danyang, Prince of Yongjia, was made Inspector of Southern Yu」: Ziren's biography has 「Southern Yan」 instead of 「Southern Yu」.

sentences.zh: 繁而傷治 「傷」各本並作「作」，據元龜一九一改。

translations.literal: Numerous and harm governance: In all editions 「harm」 appears as 「make」; the text is emended according to Imperial Readings 191.
translations.idiomatic: 「Numerous and harm governance」: All editions read 「make」 for 「harm」; the reading is corrected per Imperial Readings 191.

sentences.zh: 氣緯舛互 「互」各本並作「玄」，蓋形近而譌，今改正。

translations.literal: Erratic cosmic signs: In all editions 「mutual」 appears as 「mysterious」; this is likely a graphic error from similar forms, and is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: 「Erratic cosmic signs」: All editions have 「mysterious」 for 「mutual」, probably a graphic confusion; the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 領軍將軍王玄謨為鎮北將軍青冀二州刺史 各本「鎮北將軍」下並衍「南徐州刺史新安王子鸞為」十一字。

translations.literal: Wang Xuemo, Commander of the Palace Guards, was made General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces: Below 「General Who Guards the North」 all editions have an additional eleven characters: 「Inspector of Southern Xu, Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, was made」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Wang Xuemo…Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces」: Below 「General Who Guards the North」 every edition adds eleven spurious characters about Liu Ziluan as Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 按新安王子鸞傳，不言曾為青、冀二州刺史，而王玄謨傳，言玄謨時徙為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: According to the biography of Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, it nowhere says he was Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces; according to Wang Xuemo's biography, at this time Xuemo was transferred to be Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Ziluan's biography never makes him Inspector of Qing and Ji; Xuemo's biography shows that Xuemo, not Ziluan, held that post at this time.

sentences.zh: 今訂正。

translations.literal: The text is now emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The passage is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 己丑 各本並作「己未」。

translations.literal: Day jichou: In all editions this reads 「jiwei」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Day jichou」: All editions read 「jiwei」.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁卯朔，二十三日己丑，無己未、乙丑。

translations.literal: In this month the first day was dingmao; the twenty-third day was jichou—there was no jiwei or yichou.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on dingmao; the twenty-third was jichou—neither jiwei nor yichou occurred.

sentences.zh: 今據建康實錄及通鑑改正。

translations.literal: The text is now emended according to the Veritable Record of Jiankang and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: The date is corrected per the Veritable Record of Jiankang and the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 庚寅 各本並作「庚子」。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: In all editions this reads 「gengzi」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Day gengyin」: All editions read 「gengzi」.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁卯朔，無庚子，二十三日己丑後，二十四日有庚寅。

translations.literal: In this month the first day was dingmao; there was no gengzi. After the twenty-third day jichou, the twenty-fourth day was gengyin.
translations.idiomatic: The month opened on dingmao, so gengzi is impossible; the day after jichou (the twenty-third) was gengyin (the twenty-fourth).

sentences.zh: 今改正。

translations.literal: The text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The reading is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍宗越為司州刺史 「宗越」書中多誤作「宋越」，今據宗越傳改正。

translations.literal: Zong Yue, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Si Province: In the book 「Zong Yue」 is often wrongly written as 「Song Yue」; the text is now corrected according to Zong Yue's biography.
translations.idiomatic: 「Zong Yue…Inspector of Si Province」: The name is often miswritten 「Song Yue」; it is corrected throughout per Zong Yue's biography.

sentences.zh: 以下類此者皆逕改，不具校。

translations.literal: Similar cases below are emended directly without full collation notes.
translations.idiomatic: Similar cases below are corrected in the text without repeating full notes.

sentences.zh: 以尚書右僕射顏師伯為尚書僕射 「尚書僕射」各本作「尚書左僕射」，南史無「左」字。

translations.literal: Yan Shibo, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat: In all editions 「Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat」 appears as 「Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat」; the History of the Southern Dynasties lacks the character 「Left」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Yan Shibo…Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat」: All editions add 「Left」, which the History of the Southern Dynasties omits.

sentences.zh: 李慈銘宋書札記云：「左字衍，當據南史刪。

translations.literal: Li Ciming's Notes on the Book of Song says: 「The character Left is a spurious addition and should be deleted according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ciming's Notes on the Book of Song: 「Left is a spurious addition and should be deleted per the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 」按是時但置尚書僕射，不分立左右。

translations.literal: 」At this time only the office of Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat was established, without separate Left and Right posts.
translations.idiomatic: 」Only a single Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat existed then, not separate Left and Right posts.

sentences.zh: 今據南史刪「左」字。

translations.literal: The character 「Left」 is now deleted according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: 「Left」 is therefore deleted per the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 減州郡縣田祿之半 宋本、三朝本、北監本、毛本及南史作「田祿」。

translations.literal: The field stipends of provinces, commanderies, and counties were reduced by half: The Song edition, Three-Dynasties edition, Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, and History of the Southern Dynasties read 「field stipends」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Field stipends of provinces, commanderies, and counties were reduced by half」: The Song, Three-Dynasties, Northern Directorate, and Mao editions and the History of the Southern Dynasties read 「field stipends」.

sentences.zh: 殿本、局本作「田租」。

translations.literal: The Palace edition and Bureau edition read 「field rent」.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace and Bureau editions read 「field rent」.

sentences.zh: 建康實錄作「祿秩」。

translations.literal: The Veritable Record of Jiankang reads 「stipend ranks」.
translations.idiomatic: The Veritable Record of Jiankang has 「stipend ranks」.

sentences.zh: 按普減國內田租之半，非封建統治者所肯為，此必減州郡縣官吏田祿之半。

translations.literal: A general reduction of field rent throughout the realm by half is not something a feudal ruler would undertake; this must mean the field stipends of provincial, commandery, and county officials were reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: A realm-wide halving of field rent is implausible for a feudal ruler; the phrase must refer to halving officials' field stipends.

sentences.zh: 故建康實錄改稱為「祿秩」。

translations.literal: Therefore the Veritable Record of Jiankang changed the wording to 「stipend ranks」.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the Veritable Record of Jiankang rephrases it as 「stipend ranks」.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍南豫州刺史湘東王彧改為雍州刺史 各本並脫「南」字。

translations.literal: Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General of the Guard, was transferred to be Inspector of Yong Province: All editions omit the character 「Southern」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Liu Yu…Inspector of Yong Province」: All editions omit 「Southern」 before 「Yu」.

sentences.zh: 按明帝紀，永光元年為南豫州刺史，鎮姑孰。

translations.literal: According to the annals of Emperor Ming, in the first year of Yongguang he was Inspector of Southern Yu, garrisoning Gushu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming's annals place him as Inspector of Southern Yu at Gushu in Yongguang year 1.

sentences.zh: 又按州郡志，此時南豫州鎮姑孰，而豫州則未嘗以姑孰為州治。

translations.literal: According to the Monograph on Provinces and Commanderies, at this time Southern Yu garrisoned Gushu, while Yu Province had never used Gushu as its seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Monograph on Provinces and Commanderies shows Southern Yu at Gushu then, not Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 今據明帝紀補。

translations.literal: The character is now supplied according to the annals of Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: 「Southern」 is restored from Emperor Ming's annals.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射顏師伯 「尚書左僕射」各本並作「尚書僕射」，據南史改，說見前。

translations.literal: Yan Shibo, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat: In all editions this reads 「Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat」; it is emended according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, as explained above.
translations.idiomatic: 「Yan Shibo, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat」: All editions drop 「Left」; the title is corrected per the History of the Southern Dynasties, as noted above.

sentences.zh: 以鎮西大將軍豫州刺史山陽王休祐為鎮軍大將軍開府儀同三司 鎮西大將軍各本並作「鎮北大將軍」。

translations.literal: Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Guards the Army and Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies: In all editions 「General Who Guards the West」 appears as 「General Who Guards the North」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Liu Xiuyou…Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies」: All editions read 「General Who Guards the North」 for 「General Who Guards the West」.

sentences.zh: 上九月辛亥下作鎮西大將軍，休祐傳亦作鎮西，今改正。

translations.literal: Above, in the ninth month on xinhai day, he is made General Who Guards the West; Xiuyou's biography also reads General Who Guards the West—the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, on xinhai in the ninth month, he is General Who Guards the West, as is Xiuyou's biography—the title is corrected here.

sentences.zh: 少府劉勝之子也 「劉勝」元龜一九七及二０七同本紀。

translations.literal: The son of Liu Sheng of the Palace Storehouse: 「Liu Sheng」 appears in Imperial Readings 197 and 207 in the same annals.
translations.idiomatic: 「The son of Liu Sheng of the Palace Storehouse」: Imperial Readings 197 and 207 in this annals read 「Liu Sheng」.

sentences.zh: 符瑞志及始安王休仁傳、宋略、南史帝紀作劉矇，南史休仁傳作劉蒙。

translations.literal: The Treatise on Omens, the biography of Prince of Shi'an Liu Xiuren, the Song lüe, and the imperial annals in the History of the Southern Dynasties read Liu Meng (矇); the biography of Xiuren in the History of the Southern Dynasties reads Liu Meng (蒙).
translations.idiomatic: The Treatise on Omens, Xiuren's biography in the Song lüe, and the Southern History imperial annals have 「Liu Meng (矇)」; Xiuren's biography in the Southern History has 「Liu Meng (蒙)」.

sentences.zh: 食湯沐邑二千戶 「食」各本並作「侯」。

translations.literal: A fief of two thousand households for bath and lodging: In all editions 「for」 appears as 「marquis」.
translations.idiomatic: 「A fief of two thousand households for bath and lodging」: All editions read 「marquis」 for 「for」.

sentences.zh: 據御覽一五二改。

translations.literal: Emended according to Imperial Readings 152.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected per Imperial Readings 152.

sentences.zh: 帝少好讀書 「讀書」各本並作「講書」，據南史、元龜一九二、御覽一二八引改。

translations.literal: The emperor from youth loved reading: In all editions 「reading」 appears as 「lecturing」; emended according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, Imperial Readings 192, and the citation in Imperial Readings 128.
translations.idiomatic: 「The emperor from youth loved reading」: All editions have 「lecturing」 for 「reading」; the reading follows the Southern History, Imperial Readings 192, and the citation in Imperial Readings 128.

sentences.zh: 以建安王休仁山陽王休祐領之 各本並脫「休仁山陽王」五字，據南史補。

translations.literal: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, and Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, were made to command them: All editions omit the five characters 「Xiuren, Prince of Shanyang」; they are supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: 「Liu Xiuren… and Liu Xiuyou… were made to command them」: All editions omit 「Xiuren, Prince of Shanyang」; the phrase is restored from the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 張燴讀史舉正云：「按建安王乃休仁，休祐則山陽王也。

translations.literal: Zhang Hui's Corrections in Reading History says: 「According to the text, the Prince of Jian'an is Xiuren, and Xiuyou is the Prince of Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hui's Corrections in Reading History: 「The Prince of Jian'an is Xiuren; Xiuyou is the Prince of Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 南史作『以建安王休仁、山陽王休祐領之』為是。」

translations.literal: The History of the Southern Dynasties reading 『made Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, and Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, command them』 is correct.」
translations.idiomatic: The Southern History reading 『made Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, and Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, command them』 is correct.」
